name: breaking-wall-tom-jerry-selfie
image_purpose: cafe selfie and clearly animated character compositing reference

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic cafe selfie of an approved adult main subject with clearly animated cartoon characters integrated as 2D/3D figures.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult person seated at a small wooden cafe table, holding a smartphone slightly above eye level, wearing a casual sweater and optional scarf, with a warm natural smile.
prompt.composition_elements: Cozy cafe interior, coffee cups, pastries, wooden decor, softly blurred patrons, animated gray cat and orange mouse characters seated near the cups. Characters must remain clearly cartoon-styled and non-realistic; do not add additional named characters.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm ambient cafe lighting, soft matching shadows, shallow depth of field, cozy coffee-time mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic selfie composition with 2D/3D animated overlay, portrait 4:5, high detail, sharp subject face, believable light interaction.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Approved adult person takes a warm cafe selfie at a wooden table with coffee and pastries, while a clearly animated gray cat and orange mouse sit nearby as cartoon crossover figures. Keep the human photorealistic and the characters fully animated, with matching warm shadows and a cozy cafe background. No extra named characters, watermark, or invented logo.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, sexualized pose, nudity, realistic animal-person hybrid, horror, distorted hands, extra fingers, cartoon human subject, blurry face, watermark, logo invention, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required local image. Keep cartoon characters clearly animated and typography absent.

changes: Removed the follow-on request for additional named characters and constrained the crossover to supplied clearly animated figures.
